text: Breathe with your belly. Most people under stress breathe shallowly. This is connected with psychosomatic tensions in the chest and abdomen. In turn, such breathing gives the psyche a signal of stress, leading to increased stress. A downward spiral arises from which it is difficult to get out if there is no awareness. Although the way out is simple—as soon as you notice stress, begin to breathe with your belly, or more precisely its lower part. There is the second chakra, and in Chinese traditions—the lower dantian—the main reservoir in which life force Qi accumulates and is stored. So, place your hand on this area and feel how it gently rises on the inhale and lowers on the exhale. Even without special esoteric techniques, such an action sends the nervous system a signal of safety, calms and removes tension in the pelvic area.
